rework.R1: XGrammar 0.2.8 / PR #672: non-provably-disjoint oneOf warns and falls back to anyOf (not fail-closed)
rework.R2: frozen text-vs-local_ref XOR object arms are outside v0.2.8 published disjointness proofs
rework.R3: G9 fail_closed_behavior = UNSUPPORTED; G2a qualifies native oneOf unavailable for this shape

docs_version_reference: XGrammar 0.2.8 (includes PR #672 behavior) + published disjointness proof scope (paper only; not installed)

proceed_only_if: no required semantic feature is documented unsupported
no evidence shows XGrammar necessarily weakens the frozen schema
remaining uncertainty is empirical/constructibility rather than a known contract mismatch

prover_capabilities_v0_2_8: common required discriminator with finite disjoint const/enum values per branch
xor_shape_vs_disjointness_prover.reason: kind is the only finite common required key and its enum overlaps completely; text/local_ref are not common discriminators and are not finite const/enum; type/finite proof does not apply to these complex object schemas
xor_shape_vs_disjointness_prover.documented_converter_path: oneOf unsupported for this shape → WARNING → ParseAnyOf(...)

gates.requirement: Hard token-level masking during decode; not post-hoc validation-only.
gates.evidence: XGrammar constrained-decoding docs: per-step token bitmask applied to logits (−∞ for illegal tokens). HF path: xgr.contrib.hf.LogitsProcessor(compiled_grammar).
gates.rationale: Public architecture is explicit token-mask constrained decoding via GrammarMatcher.fill_next_token_bitmask / HF LogitsProcessor.

gates.requirement: Exact support for the frozen patched ClosedNormalizedProgram JSON Schema artifact (full nesting, enums, nullables, XOR patch).
gates.evidence: compile_json_schema accepts schema string/dict/Pydantic; Draft 2020-12 subset documented. JSON-Schema route for our XOR oneOf is rejected on G9 policy grounds before fidelity probing.
gates.rationale: Broader compile surface remains plausible; route blocked by fail-closed policy mismatch, not by claiming full-schema compile impossible.

gates.requirement: Exact XOR oneOf for ClosedSemanticQuery branches (text-only vs local_ref-only); reject both/neither.
gates.evidence: XGrammar 0.2.8 (PR #672): when oneOf branches are not proven pairwise disjoint, converter warns and recompiles via ParseAnyOf (anyOf semantics). Published disjointness proofs cover common required discriminator with finite disjoint const/enum, or simple type/finite arms — not our text-vs-local_ref object arms with overlapping kind enums. Native fail-closed oneOf handling is unavailable for this shape. Resulting anyOf language may still equal intended oneOf if additionalProperties:false is faithful (xor_both equivalence remains empirical), but that does not restore native oneOf fail-closed.
gates.rationale: NATIVE_ONEOF_UNSUPPORTED_FOR_THIS_SHAPE; anyOf-equivalence of acceptance language remains empirically testable but is moot for Stage A progression after G9 UNSUPPORTED.

gates.requirement: pattern ".*\\S.*" on text/local_ref matching Pydantic strip()!="" (reject empty/whitespace including tab; accept surrounded whitespace).
gates.evidence: String pattern keyword is supported and converted via RegexConverter (ECMA-262 subset). Documented regex limits exclude backrefs, assertions, Unicode property escapes, {x,y} — not used by .*\\S.*. Exact tab/escape fidelity against JSON string encoding is unproven on paper.
gates.rationale: pattern is not documented unsupported; moot for JSON-Schema Stage B after REJECT_BACKEND.

gates.requirement: additionalProperties:false enforced on closed objects (incl. XOR branches and ClosedModel surfaces).
gates.evidence: Object additionalProperties / unevaluatedProperties handled in converter; strict_mode default true enforces unevaluatedProperties/Items false. PR #594 tests additionalProperties:false with properties coexistence.
gates.rationale: Documented first-class support with strict_mode default aligned to closed schemas.

gates.evidence: Converter recognizes $defs and definitions; $ref via JSON Pointer with circular-ref handling documented.
gates.rationale: Required reference mechanism is documented supported.

gates.requirement: ACCEPT text-only / local_ref-only; REJECT both / neither (PREFLIGHT parity).
gates.evidence: Because the schema enters warn→anyOf for this oneOf shape, acceptance-language equivalence to exact oneOf depends on faithful per-branch additionalProperties:false under the union grammar. Not claimed false-accept of xor_both on paper; not proven either.
gates.rationale: Empirical residual only; does not override G9 UNSUPPORTED.

gates.requirement: Reject empty/whitespace-only including tab; accept non-whitespace with optional surrounding spaces.
gates.evidence: Same as G2b; PREFLIGHT-01R showed Outlines false-accepted tab via JSON escape.
gates.rationale: Empirical gate; moot for rejected JSON-Schema Stage B.

gates.requirement: Compatible with exact pinned local Qwen3-1.7B tokenizer (HF fast tokenizer path).
gates.evidence: TokenizerInfo.from_huggingface documented; supports HF fast/tiktoken/SentencePiece. Official tests use Qwen tokenizers. Vocab-size caveat: pass config.vocab_size when logits dim ≠ tokenizer vocab.
gates.rationale: In-principle HF/Qwen support remains; not used to authorize Stage B after REJECT_BACKEND.

gates.requirement: compile_json_schema + matcher/logits-processor construction succeeds for full patched schema without DFA/state blow-up.
gates.evidence: XGrammar uses grammar compilation + adaptive token-mask cache (different engine than outlines_core Index). Unproven for our schema; moot after REJECT_BACKEND for JSON-Schema route.
gates.rationale: Empirical; not required after Stage A reject.

gates.requirement: No semantic repair, soft validation-and-fix, or schema weakening in the constraint path.
gates.evidence: Documented mechanism is generative masking only. No XGrammar feature described as post-decode semantic normalization of operands/ops.
gates.rationale: Architecture is preventative token masking; oneOf→anyOf is a compilation fallback policy issue (G9), not a post-decode repair API.

gates.requirement: Deterministic, pinnable artifact/version provenance for backend + compiled constraint.
gates.evidence: Released versions on GitHub/PyPI (docs tagged 0.2.8); compile_json_schema is a pure function of schema + TokenizerInfo + compile kwargs.
gates.rationale: Version pinning path exists on paper.

gates.requirement: Unsupported/unsound constructs fail closed rather than silently weaken/fallback.
gates.evidence: XGrammar 0.2.8 includes PR #672 behavior: for oneOf branches not proven pairwise disjoint, converter logs a warning and deliberately recompiles as anyOf (ParseAnyOf). Our frozen XOR object-arm shape is outside the published disjointness proofs, so it enters that warn→anyOf path. Frozen G9 forbids silent weaken/fallback for unsupported/unsound constructs; this is documented opposite behavior.
gates.rationale: Required gate UNSUPPORTED on paper → Stage A REJECT_BACKEND. Not rescued by possible anyOf≡oneOf acceptance equivalence for xor_both.

residual_risks: REJECT_BACKEND closes the XGrammar JSON-Schema route for Stage A; does not evaluate CFG/EBNF representation
anyOf acceptance equivalence to oneOf for xor_both remains untested and is not used to proceed
pattern .*\S.* tab/JSON-escape fidelity remains unproven (moot for this route)
XGrammar may still be considered later as an EBNF/grammar engine under a separate design AUTH
stage_a_disposition_meaning: Required G9 is UNSUPPORTED for the frozen JSON-Schema+oneOf route under XGrammar 0.2.8. Does NOT authorize install, Stage B, CFG/EBNF redesign, or PILOT-01.
